# osapi agent service

Run the agent of this host as a service that starts at boot.
`osapi dsl command get --name agent service` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                             |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | agent service                                               |
| Description | Run the agent of this host as a service that starts at boot |

## [osapi agent service install](../../usage/cli/agent/service/install.md)

|             |                                                                  |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | install                                                          |
| Description | Install the agent as a service, with a join string, and start it |
| Refuses     | no join string, a join string of more than 8192 characters       |

### Flags (3)

| FLAG     | TYPE               | VALIDATE          | HELP                                                                   |
| -------- | ------------------ | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| --join   | string             | required,max=8192 | The join string that osapi controller join token create printed.       |
| --labels | map\[string]string | omitempty         | Labels of the host, as key=value, beside the labels of the join token. |
| --force  | bool               | omitempty         | Replace a config file that exists.                                     |

## [osapi agent service uninstall](../../usage/cli/agent/service/uninstall.md)

|             |                                        |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Method      | uninstall                              |
| Description | Stop the agent's service and remove it |

### Flags (1)

| FLAG    | TYPE | VALIDATE  | HELP                                                           |
| ------- | ---- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| --purge | bool | omitempty | Also remove the config file and the keys of agent.pki.key_dir. |
